about: A7 tRNA test of P10K's Euplotes CUG label (PREREGISTRATION_A7.md). Roles: positive = known nuclear CUG-Ser yeast (P12); negative = ciliate that reads CUG as Leu (P13); main = Euplotes focardii strain TN1 genome (P14); euplotes = other Euplotes genomes (P15); transcriptome = the two TN1 transcriptomes (secondary, A7.5). Run in this order. Accessions checked against NCBI Datasets and ENA on 2026-11-20.
